WITH combined AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(t.zipcode, i.zipcode) AS zipcode,
        t.boroname,
        t.tree_id,
        i.Estimate_Median_income,
        i.Estimate_Mean_income
    FROM modern_data.main.trees t
    FULL OUTER JOIN modern_data.main.income_trees i ON t.zipcode = i.zipcode
)
SELECT 
    boroname, 
    COUNT(tree_id) as tree_count, 
    AVG(Estimate_Mean_income) as avg_mean_income
FROM combined
WHERE Estimate_Median_income > 0 
  AND Estimate_Mean_income > 0 
  AND boroname IS NOT NULL 
  AND boroname != '5'
GROUP BY boroname
ORDER BY tree_count DESC
LIMIT 3
